subject: Charged twice this month
body: My card statement shows two charges from Fernwheel on May 1, both for $61.01. I only have one account and one subscription. Please refund the second charge and tell me why it happened.

subject: Recurring jobs showing up twice
body: I set up a monthly maintenance visit for one of my customers and now the calendar shows it twice on the same day. Did I do something wrong when I saved it? Not sure if I should delete one or if that kills both.

subject: App crashes when uploading job photos
body: Every time one of my guys tries to attach more than three photos to a job on Android, the app closes on its own. He's on an Android phone, latest app version. It's happened on four jobs this week and we're losing the photos.

subject: Upgrading to Crew
body: We just hired two more crew members and we want the dispatch board and invoicing, which Starter doesn't include. What's the cleanest way to move up to the Crew plan, and does our schedule data carry over as-is?

subject: Reminder texts going out at 5am
body: Two customers complained that their appointment reminder texts arrived at 5:04 in the morning. I have reminders set for 8am in the settings, or at least I thought I did. Can you check what time zone my account is using?

subject: Invoices not showing up in QuickBooks
body: I connected QuickBooks last week and it pulled in my customer list fine, but none of the invoices I've created since then have synced over. Is there a button I'm supposed to press each time or is it supposed to be automatic?

subject: Billed after I canceled
body: I canceled my subscription on May 9 and got a confirmation email, and then on May 15 you charged me $30.14 anyway. This needs to be refunded. I kept the cancellation email if you need it.

subject: Tech can't see his jobs on the map view
body: One of my techs opens the dispatch map and it's blank for him, but the list view shows all five of his jobs today. Works fine for everybody else. He's already logged out and back in twice.

subject: CSV export missing the job notes column
body: I exported all completed jobs for April to CSV and the file has dates, customers, and totals but no job notes column, even though I checked the notes box in the export screen. Am I misreading the export options or is that column not included on purpose?

subject: Offline notes disappearing on iOS
body: My route takes me through spots with no signal, and the app says it saves offline. Twice now I've typed up job notes with no service and they were gone by the time I got back to the shop. iOS phone, app updated last week. What am I losing here?

subject: Customer not notified when I moved their appointment
body: I dragged a Thursday appointment to Friday on the calendar and assumed the customer would get an updated text, but she showed up expecting us Thursday. Does rescheduling by drag and drop send a notification or do I have to trigger that separately?

subject: Downgrading from Fleet to Crew
body: We're down to six techs after the spring rush so Fleet is more than we need. If we drop to Crew, do we lose QuickBooks sync and API access right away, and do we keep our job history?

subject: What is the usage overage line on my invoice?
body: My June invoice has a $12 line item called usage overage and I have no idea what it's for. I'm on Starter and I thought the bill was $29 a tech and nothing else. Can someone break down what I actually used?

subject: Customers reply to reminder texts and we never see it
body: Three customers this week said they texted back to reschedule and nobody answered them. I can't find their replies anywhere in Fernwheel. Where do those messages go? This is making us look like we're ignoring people.

subject: QuickBooks sync created duplicate customers
body: After the sync ran over the weekend I now have two entries for almost every customer in QuickBooks, one from before and one that Fernwheel pushed over. Which side should I clean up, and how do I keep it from happening again next sync?

subject: Dispatch board frozen, can't assign anything
body: The dispatch board has been spinning for 20 minutes and I have nine techs sitting in the parking lot waiting on assignments. I've refreshed, cleared cache, tried a different browser. I need this working now or I'm writing today's schedule on a whiteboard.

subject: Webhook for completed jobs?
body: Our office manager built a little spreadsheet tool that pulls from your API. Right now we poll every hour, which is clunky. Is there a webhook that fires when a job is marked complete, and where do I generate a second API key so the tool isn't using my admin key?

subject: GPS clock-in says my tech was 30 miles away
body: The timesheet shows one of my techs clocking in from a town 30 miles from the job site, but the homeowner confirms he was there on time. He clocked in from the Android app in the driveway. I don't want to dock a guy over a glitch, so can you tell me where that location reading comes from?

subject: Refund on unused annual plan time
body: We paid for the annual plan in January and we're closing the business at the end of July. I couldn't find anything on your site about refunds for unused time. What would we actually get back for the five unused months?

subject: Adding two seats mid-cycle
body: We're bringing on two seasonal installers next Monday and I need them in the system before then. If I add seats today, is it prorated for the rest of the cycle or do I pay the full month? Just want to know what the charge will be before I click the button.
